support_line: More capacity. But is it worth it?
scene_subject: two open natural-corrugated shipping boxes of different proportions containing the same kind of neutral product pack, communicating a smaller and larger case-pack decision without an exact visibly countable total

supported_claims.evidence: The approved article compares an 8-products-per-carton baseline with a 16-products-per-carton alternative and reports their matched pallet results.
